scope: Read-only audit of retained original probabilities and inference with original fitted bundles; aggregates only, without protected file paths, identifiers or patient-level records
internal_ci_method: DeLong normal-approximation interval using event/non-event placement contributions with half credit for tied scores; variance var(V10,ddof=1)/m + var(V01,ddof=1)/n; two-sided normal 0.975 quantile; bounds clipped to [0,1]

reduced_internal_test.source_role: retained original reduced-model internal-test labels and probabilities

benchmark_internal_test.source_role: retained original locked-benchmark internal-test labels and probabilities

reduced_temporal_parent_cohort.source_role: original fitted-bundle inference in original prepared-workbook order

benchmark_temporal_parent_cohort.source_role: original fitted-bundle inference in original prepared-workbook order

Third_Xiangya_reduced_exploratory.source_role: retained original exploratory labels and probabilities in original prediction order

USC_FAH_reduced_exploratory.source_role: retained original exploratory labels and probabilities in original prediction order

non_internal_ci_method.implementation: resample event and non-event row indices separately with replacement, concatenate events then non-events, calculate AUROC, take 0.025 and 0.975 quantiles

limitations: The older published finite-bootstrap resampling path is not reconstructed; the final reported intervals instead use the directly regenerated canonical 2000-resample seed-42 policy.
Older cached temporal benchmark predictions were not substituted for canonical original-bundle inference, which reproduces current AUROC and Brier scores exactly.
This stored-probability audit is not model retraining, a complete raw-database extraction or independent clinical validation.
